items.title: Epoch estimates Anthropic's compute spending is growing about 4x per year
items.summary_en: An Epoch Data Insight estimates Anthropic's compute spend is rising roughly 4x per year, versus roughly 3x for OpenAI. It draws on Anthropic's S-1 filing.
items.notes: epoch.ai could not be fetched directly (domain not allowed in this session). Content and date come from a search-result snippet of the primary page, so verify against the live page. Epoch's snippet says OpenAI data is sparser than Anthropic's, so the comparison is less certain for OpenAI.

items.title: Epoch: AI inference capacity grew 4.6x in one year
items.summary_en: An Epoch Data Insight uses its Inference Performance Index and chip sales data. It finds agentic inference capacity grew about 4.6x in a year, against about 2.6x for 8-bit compute capacity.
items.notes: Snippet-based, not fetched directly. The search tool described the newest items as dated Nov 17-18, so the exact date for this item is uncertain (set to 2026-11-17 as a best estimate). Epoch reports 90% uncertainty intervals: 4.2-5.1x for inference growth. Verify on the live page.

items.title: Epoch report: tested models fall short of Epoch employee standard on real work tasks
items.summary_en: According to a search snippet, an Epoch report tested several AI models on Epoch's own work tasks. None met the standard of Epoch employees, including the two models that top the Epoch Capabilities Index (ECI).
items.notes: Weakest item. The report's own URL and exact title were not retrieved, so the link is the general feed page. The date comes from a search summary. Task set, sample size and grading method are unknown and should be checked in the original. Relevant to the divergence between benchmark gains and real-world reliability.

items.title: Epoch updates Epoch Capabilities Index methodology to a Bayesian model (pre-window)
items.summary_en: Epoch published a report on changing the Epoch Capabilities Index (ECI) methodology to use a Bayesian model. The ECI is Epoch's composite measure of model capabilities across benchmarks.
items.notes: PRE-WINDOW (before 2026-11-11). Included for context only. Report URL not retrieved. The methodology change may alter earlier ECI rankings, so compare with prior ECI figures before citing.

items.title: Epoch report on Huawei's Horinger data center (pre-window)
items.summary_en: Epoch's blog lists a report on a Huawei data center at Horinger. No further detail was retrieved.
items.notes: PRE-WINDOW (before 2026-11-11). Only the title and date were seen in a search summary. No findings are stated here, and none should be inferred.
